item.title: @thejayalto: as a kid, i never appreciated how, when my parents left the house, they were literally unreachable. no phones, no intern
item.description: as a kid, i never appreciated how, when my parents left the house, they were literally unreachable. no phones, no internet; gone until they got back and checked the voicemail. nothing ever went wrong, yet we still decided to normalise the idea of always being available to anyone.
item.content:encoded:
@thejayalto

as a kid, i never appreciated how, when my parents left the house, they were literally unreachable. no phones, no internet; gone until they got back and checked the voicemail. nothing ever went wrong, yet we still decided to normalise the idea of always being available to anyone.
